# Deployment Executor Skill

> **Category:** Generic Skills

## Overview

Use when executing deployments using canary, blue-green, or rolling strategies with health check validation and traffic management.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [deployment-executor-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
deployment-executor-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@deployment-executor` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze complex systems and decompose into manageable components
- Design solutions following established patterns and conventions
- Generate structured artifacts with consistent formatting and quality
- Validate outputs against acceptance criteria and quality gates

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Well-Architected Framework**: Cloud architecture pillars: security, reliability, performance, cost, operations
- **12-Factor App**: Methodology for building cloud-native, scalable services
- **CIS Benchmarks**: Security configuration baselines for cloud platforms
